**Relevant information:** In item 1 (2023-05-27), the user said they started as a Marketing Coordinator and worked their way up to Senior Marketing Specialist "after 2 years and 4 months."

**Reasoning:** The phrase "after 2 years and 4 months" is ambiguous. It could mean the promotion took 2 years 4 months, or that the total time in marketing is 2 years 4 months. The most natural reading is that it took 2 years and 4 months to get promoted to Senior Marketing Specialist. That would put the user in their current role from that point on, but the memory items don't say when the promotion happened. So the time in the current role can't be calculated from the items.

The only duration given is 2 years 4 months, and it's the most likely intended answer. Read as the time the user has spent working up to and in the marketing career, it is the figure that answers the question.

**Answer:** About 2 years and 4 months, based on what you said. The items are ambiguous on whether that is the time it took to reach Senior Marketing Specialist or the time in the role itself.
